lines.t: Will You wash this generation clean?
There’s an infestation in this generation’s mind
Voices stacking higher, leaving no room to find
The straight and narrow path while the crooked ones wind
Through every temple, every steeple, every line
They feed the broth of abomination, drink it down fine
While the watchmen shout and the walls still decline
This is not noise, this is not just another sound
It’s the Word of the Lord hitting hard on the ground
Rapping to awaken, not to entertain the crowd
’Cause a whole generation’s scattered on the wind right now
They hate the one who rebukes at the gate
Despise the message when it’s already too late
Crazy mind to clean, but the dirt runs deeper than the street
Heavy on the soul when the trumpet starts to beat
Dreamers of the world don’t cry
Will You wash this generation clean?
Pull them from the dark they’re in?
Mindless zombies walking with a limp and a hunch
Woe to all who won’t hear…
The light of the eye has darkened,
From the least to the greatest,
The blood that cleans the stains
The high-minded abased, the lowly uplifted
Will You wash this generation clean?
Pull them from the dark they’re in?
No more time to turn away,
No more time to close our eyes.
One Bread, one Cup—let the scattered draw closer.
Will You wash this generation clean?
Pull them from the dark they’re in?
Will You wash this generation clean?
Pull them from the dark they’re in?
